g.title: System
g.text: Edge devices work with no internet (Bluetooth mesh, LAN); any phone that finds signal links the mesh to the cloud control room.

g.title: edge_
g.text: Bluetooth LE mesh · local Wi-Fi · no dependency on the cloud
indradhanu_bridge: signed IDX1 S, phone first
heartbeat · forward IDX1 queue · civ-sync bundle
cache centres + routes · Tor only if Arti is up
service worker: offline outbox, replay on signal
mesh mode via local bitchat API

g.title: cloud
g.text: /api/v1 · staff JWT (Supabase Auth) · devices by X-Mesh-Gateway-Key · packets by HMAC
tails the event log · triggers cycles

g.title: front
g.text: IndexedDB cache (snapshot, ward geometry, map pictures) · service worker (Mapbox styles / fonts)
Command wall (zone screens + analytics) · Live map
Live feed · Incidents & response · Mesh & devices
Approvals · Agent graph · Copilot · Emergency stop
